_: What is true right now, for the managers. This is the one place that is kept current: WhatsApp messages go out, get corrected, and are read out of order. Edit this file whenever something is settled or changes, and change `updated` to that day.
agreed: The week runs Monday to Sunday. Counting starts Monday 9 November.
A tester is paid for each app tested: 100 KES a small app, 150 a normal one, 250 a big one.
Plus 50 KES for a report that finds a real problem — nobody has to confirm it — and 100 KES in any week they use an app on 5 days out of 7.
A report the app accepted is a paid test. Failing the challenge does not cost the tester the money.

Money Jerry has sent: Emmanuel 50,000 KES (30,000 on 8 November and 20,000 on 11 November) and Veronicah 30,000 KES. The Money tab lists each one. You pay your team out of it and write each payment down here.
You do the paying, not Jerry. A tester asks you about their own pay.
This page is yours alone. Emmanuel sees team 1, Veronicah sees team 2.
Some of what you are owed is the Zuri closing pay, marked on the row it belongs to. It is paid the same way as testing pay.

This week only (9 to 15 November): Veronicah's team, whose working link came on Wednesday, gets the 100 KES daily-use bonus for 4 days of use instead of 5. It is added at Monday's weekly close, as a one-off on the row. From Monday 16 November it is 5 days again for everyone. Nobody needs to reset anything.

Friday 13 November, a push to finish. The Daraja store is open and every app that passed testing is free, with an optional gift to Loving InDeed. Ask your team to do Advent Together first (its doors open on 1 December), then any app they have not done, and any app their page says to run again. It is on their news at the top. Nothing about pay changes: each app by its size, and a run-again after an update is paid again.
note: Friday 13 November, morning. Busy night: Shamsuddin sent eight apps, Jane Njeri two, and Faith Wangari and Emmanuel one each.
